description: Use this when a user asks what a university or college charges students per year (tuition or registration fees for a bachelor's or master's degree) in Canada (country CA), Europe (country BE), Europe (country BG), Europe (country CZ), Europe (country DK), Europe (country DE), Europe (country EE), Europe (country IE), Europe (country GR), Europe (country ES), Europe (country FR), Europe (country HR), Europe (country IT), Europe (country CY), Europe (country LV), Europe (country LT), Europe (country LU), Europe (country HU), Europe (country MT), Europe (country NL), Europe (country AT), Europe (country PL), Europe (country PT), Europe (country RO), Europe (country SI), Europe (country SK), Europe (country FI), Europe (country SE), Europe (country AL), Europe (country BA), Europe (country CH), Europe (country IS), Europe (country LI), Europe (country ME), Europe (country MK), Europe (country NO), Europe (country RS), Europe (country TR) or Taiwan (country TW), or how fees compare between countries or between home and international students. Returns the official statutory fee levels published for a country and academic year: the most common annual fee, the minimum and the maximum, in national currency with a euro equivalent. These are posted fee levels set by law or by universities, not what any one student paid and not a range built from sales: there is no sample size. How fresh: Canada: annual: one value per academic year (2026/2027 was published on 16 September 2026); every answer names its academic year; Europe: academic year 2023/24 (Eurydice release of September 2025); updated about once a year; Taiwan: annual: one value per academic year (the Ministry updates the file every October for the new year); every answer names its academic year. Fees are before grants, loans and fee waivers. Do not use for the price of one named course or university, living costs or rent, school fees, or countries that are not listed.

community.description: BE only: the higher-education system, because Belgium has three with different fees: fr (French Community), nl (Flemish Community) or de (German-speaking Community).

country.description: CA = Canada (Statistics Canada: average posted tuition fees of publicly funded universities, by province, Canadian or international students, undergraduate or graduate); European countries as ISO codes (GR for Greece): BE = Belgium, BG = Bulgaria, CZ = Czechia, DK = Denmark, DE = Germany, EE = Estonia, IE = Ireland, GR = Greece, ES = Spain, FR = France, HR = Croatia, IT = Italy, CY = Cyprus, LV = Latvia, LT = Lithuania, LU = Luxembourg, HU = Hungary, MT = Malta, NL = Netherlands, AT = Austria, PL = Poland, PT = Portugal, RO = Romania, SI = Slovenia, SK = Slovakia, FI = Finland, SE = Sweden, AL = Albania, BA = Bosnia and Herzegovina, CH = Switzerland, IS = Iceland, LI = Liechtenstein, ME = Montenegro, MK = North Macedonia, NO = Norway, RS = Serbia, TR = Turkey; TW = Taiwan (Ministry of Education: posted tuition and miscellaneous fee standards per semester, bachelor's day programmes, by faculty group)

cycle.description: Degree level: first = bachelor's (first cycle, the default), second = master's (second cycle). Also accepts bachelor, master, undergraduate, postgraduate. Canada, Statistics Canada: first = undergraduate (default), second = graduate (master's and doctorate). Europe, Eurydice: first = bachelor's (default), second = master's. Taiwan: first = bachelor's (the only level in the file).

faculty.description: Taiwan only: faculty group (medicine, dentistry, medical_college, engineering, science_agri, business, humanities_law, other). Default humanities_law. Words like law, business, engineering, medicine, nursing also work.

ownership.description: Taiwan only: public or private institutions (default both).

province.description: Canada only: a province (Ontario, Quebec, BC, Alberta ...) or leave out for the Canada average. Yukon is mostly not published; the other territories are not in the table.

school_type.description: Taiwan only: university (general universities) or technical (technical and vocational colleges); default both.

student_group.description: Who pays: home (nationals and EU students who pay home fees, the default), international (students from outside the EU/EEA), non-state-subsidised (self-financed places), specific-discipline (for example medicine), foreign-language (courses taught in another language). Canada, Statistics Canada: home = Canadian citizens and permanent residents (default) or international. Other groups are not published. Europe, Eurydice: home (default), international (non-EU/EEA), non-state-subsidised, specific-discipline, foreign-language. Not every group exists in every country: the answer says when a fee is not available. Taiwan: one fee standard per institution; home is the only group.

study_mode.description: full-time (the default) or part-time. Canada: full-time only (the default). Europe, Eurydice: full-time (default) or part-time. Taiwan: full-time day programmes only (the default).

name: pricepaid_tuition_fees

outputSchema.description: A price answer: a range or an official statistic with sample size, period, confidence, source and licence.

answer_id.description: Audit trail: a stable id (hash of source id, normalised query, data period and method_version). The same question on the same data gives the same id; keep it with the reasoning that used the figure.

as_of.description: When the answer was produced (ISO 8601); the snapshot date when the official source was down and the answer comes from our copy.

data_age_days.description: Whole days between data_as_of and retrieved_at; null when data_as_of is null.

data_as_of.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the newest data point behind the figure; null when unknown.

evidence.description: Audit trail: what kind of evidence the figure is.

label.description: Short name of the kind of evidence, e.g. 'Recorded sale prices', 'Official published average', 'Official published index', 'Posted shelf or pump price', 'Posted or listed price', 'Contract award value', 'Regulated reimbursement price'.

meaning.description: One sentence on what this kind of evidence does and does not establish.

extra.description: Source-specific details (for example cheapest stations). extra.stale is true when the answer comes from our copy of the source.

method_version.description: Audit trail: version of the way this source turns raw data into an answer (per source, default '1').

notice.description: Information, not a valuation or offer. Also says when the answer is our copy because the official source did not respond.

period.description: The period the records cover (ISO dates), or the date of the snapshot when the answer comes from our copy.

anyOf.description: The price. Null when there is not enough data to publish a figure (fewer than 5 records) or nothing matched.

measure.description: What value is: median for ranges built from records; average or median for official statistics.

typical_high.description: 90th percentile; null for official statistics that give no range.

typical_low.description: 10th percentile; null for official statistics that give no range.

unit.description: What the price is per, e.g. 'per litre', 'per home', 'per kWh'.

value.description: The headline figure. For ranges built from records it equals median.

price_type.description: transaction, posted_pump_price, posted_price, contract_price, reimbursement_price or official_statistic.

query.description: The request as understood, echoed back.

reliability.description: How far to trust the figure as a distribution of real prices. official_with_count = a published official figure with a record count; official_median_no_count = a published average or median with no record count (confidence 'high' there means the publisher is official, not that a count was checked); record_level = 15+ records we hold; thin = 5–14 records; stale = our copy because the official source did not respond; insufficient_data = no figure published.

retrieved_at.description: Audit trail: when ProofPrice produced this answer (ISO 8601). For an answer from our own copy this is now, while as_of is the snapshot date.

sample_size.description: Number of records behind the figure; null when the publisher does not say.

source.description: Where the figure comes from, under which licence, and the attribution line to show.

attribution.description: The attribution line to show with the figure.

url.description: The publisher's page for this data.

statistic.description: Official statistics only: what kind of figure it is and the period the publisher states it for.

status.description: ok = a figure is returned; insufficient_data = fewer than 5 matching records; no_matches = nothing matched.

suggestions.description: Short plain things to try next: widen the period or area, ask for an itemised quote. May be empty.

summary.description: One plain sentence an AI can quote.

title: University tuition fees
